up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows meeting the following criteria: Target is the human protein CHEMBL2157853 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 28). Filter for activity rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and pChEMBL value is not null. Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays table), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2157853' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
